# PercentageUtils
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/percentage/contracts/PercentageUtils.sol)

**Title:**
PercentageUtils

**Author:**
Roberto Cano

Utility library to apply percentage calculations to input amounts

This library provides functions for adding, subtracting, and applying
percentages to amounts, as well as utility functions for working with
percentages.


## Functions
### addPercentage

Adds the percentage to the given amount and returns the result

It performs the following operation: (100.0% + percentage) * amount


```solidity
function addPercentage(uint256 amount, Percentage percentage) internal pure returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The base amount to which the percentage will be added|
|`percentage`|`Percentage`|The percentage to add to the amount|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount after the percentage is applied|


### subtractPercentage

Subtracts the percentage from the given amount and returns the result

It performs the following operation: (100.0% - percentage) * amount


```solidity
function subtractPercentage(uint256 amount, Percentage percentage) internal pure returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The base amount from which the percentage will be subtracted|
|`percentage`|`Percentage`|The percentage to subtract from the amount|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount after the percentage is applied|


### applyPercentage

Applies the given percentage to the given amount and returns the result

This function is used internally by addPercentage and subtractPercentage


```solidity
function applyPercentage(uint256 amount, Percentage percentage) internal pure returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount to apply the percentage to|
|`percentage`|`Percentage`|The percentage to apply to the amount|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount after the percentage is applied|


### isPercentageInRange

Checks if the given percentage is in range, this is, if it is between 0 and 100

This function is useful for validating input percentages


```solidity
function isPercentageInRange(Percentage percentage) internal pure returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`percentage`|`Percentage`|The percentage to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if the percentage is in range, false otherwise|


### fromFraction

Converts the given fraction into a percentage with the right number of decimals

This function is useful for converting ratios to percentages
For example, fromFraction(1, 2) returns 50%


```solidity
function fromFraction(uint256 numerator, uint256 denominator) internal pure returns (Percentage);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`numerator`|`uint256`|The numerator of the fraction|
|`denominator`|`uint256`|The denominator of the fraction|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`Percentage`|The percentage with `PERCENTAGE_DECIMALS` decimals|


### fromIntegerPercentage

Converts the given integer into a percentage

This function is useful for converting human-readable percentages to the internal representation


```solidity
function fromIntegerPercentage(uint256 percentage) internal pure returns (Percentage);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`percentage`|`uint256`|The percentage in human-readable format, i.e., 50 for 50%|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`Percentage`|The percentage with `PERCENTAGE_DECIMALS` decimals|
